READY: #2637 at fcc9a8e6d2 (BUG-2007, STANDARD risk, CI green)
Root cause: the shared codex app-server daemon carries the env (role+grant) of the shell that started it; daemon-attached codex TUIs ran hooks as advisor. Fix: --no-daemon on aida agent new/resume codex; hooks report role unresolved under a codex app-server ancestor. e2e + 4 hook cases, mutation-checked.
Also #2634 CI is green again at b1a8324c9d.
